newsitem.title: CROATIA: Daimler-Benz for business in Croatia - report.
newsitem.headline: Daimler-Benz for business in Croatia - report.

text.p: German industrial giant Daimler-Benz AG plans to start operations in Croatia and develop long-term business cooperation with the country, the state news agency HINA said on Wednesday.
A Daimler delegation is on a three-day visit to Zagreb where it has met deputy prime minister Borislav Skegro and the head of the president's office, Hrvoje Sarinic.
"We talked about cooperation in several areas, including agriculture, car industry and tourism," Skegro told HINA.
Daimler's deputy head Matthias Kleinert was quoted by HINA as saying his company was ready for long-term cooperation with Croatia.
"There are multiple ways of cooperation which would include Mercedes Benz, Daimler Benz Interservices (Debis) and Daimler Benz Aerospace (DASA)," Kleinert was quoted as saying.
HINA said the Daimler delegation informed Sarinic of the company's plan to open a branch in Croatia.
